content: Kiara Sen called Vikram Patel to follow up on her health insurance policy renewal (SH-123456) after submitting the form and paying the premium upfront. Vikram encountered a technical issue where the system incorrectly displays the policy as expired. He assured Kiara he would escalate the issue to ensure her coverage remains active and promised to follow up by the end of the day.

action_items: Escalate the policy status update issue in the system
Vikram to follow up with Kiara by the end of the day to confirm the update
